business_subscriptions_period_valid.name: business_subscriptions_period_valid
business_subscriptions_period_valid.value: "business_subscriptions"."status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAYMENT_FAILED') OR ("business_subscriptions"."current_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "business_subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "business_subscriptions"."current_period_start")

candidate_profiles_arrays.name: candidate_profiles_arrays
candidate_profiles_arrays.value: jsonb_typeof("candidate_profiles"."skills") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("candidate_profiles"."skills") <= 40 AND jsonb_typeof("candidate_profiles"."experiences") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("candidate_profiles"."experiences") <= 20 AND jsonb_typeof("candidate_profiles"."education") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("candidate_profiles"."education") <= 10 AND jsonb_typeof("candidate_profiles"."portfolio_links") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("candidate_profiles"."portfolio_links") <= 5

conversations_shape_check.name: conversations_shape_check
conversations_shape_check.value: (kind = 'ORDER' AND order_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'AI' AND order_id IS NULL AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND market_id IS NOT NULL)

jobs_salary_valid.name: jobs_salary_valid
jobs_salary_valid.value: ("jobs"."salary_min_minor" IS NULL AND "jobs"."salary_max_minor" IS NULL AND "jobs"."salary_currency" IS NULL AND "jobs"."salary_period" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."salary_min_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."salary_min_minor" >= 1 AND ("jobs"."salary_max_minor" IS NULL OR "jobs"."salary_max_minor" >= "jobs"."salary_min_minor") AND "jobs"."salary_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."salary_period" IN ('HOUR', 'DAY', 'MONTH', 'YEAR'))

jobs_lifecycle_consistent.name: jobs_lifecycle_consistent
jobs_lifecycle_consistent.value: ("jobs"."status" IN ('PUBLISHED', 'PAUSED') AND "jobs"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "jobs"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "jobs"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

listing_promotions_payment_source_status.name: listing_promotions_payment_source_status
listing_promotions_payment_source_status.value: ("listing_promotions"."payment_source" = 'SIMULATED_PROVIDER') OR ("listing_promotions"."payment_source" = 'COMMERCIAL_BALANCE' AND "listing_promotions"."payment_status" = 'BALANCE_CHARGED') OR ("listing_promotions"."payment_source" = 'BUNDLE_ENTITLEMENT' AND "listing_promotions"."payment_status" = 'ENTITLEMENT_CONSUMED' AND "listing_promotions"."entitlement_id" IS NOT NULL)

listing_promotions_budget_valid.name: listing_promotions_budget_valid
listing_promotions_budget_valid.value: "listing_promotions"."spent_minor" >= 0 AND "listing_promotions"."released_minor" >= 0 AND "listing_promotions"."budget_promo_minor" >= 0 AND "listing_promotions"."tax_minor" >= 0 AND ("listing_promotions"."budget_minor" IS NULL AND "listing_promotions"."spent_minor" = 0 AND "listing_promotions"."released_minor" = 0 AND "listing_promotions"."budget_promo_minor" = 0 OR "listing_promotions"."budget_minor" > 0 AND "listing_promotions"."budget_promo_minor" <= "listing_promotions"."budget_minor" AND "listing_promotions"."spent_minor" + "listing_promotions"."released_minor" <= "listing_promotions"."budget_minor")

listing_promotions_budget_terms.name: listing_promotions_budget_terms
listing_promotions_budget_terms.value: ("listing_promotions"."charging_mode_snapshot" = 'PREPAID_BUDGET') = ("listing_promotions"."budget_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_promotions"."unit_charge_minor_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

markets_price_valid.name: markets_price_valid
markets_price_valid.value: minor_unit_scale BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND ((unit_price_minor IS NULL AND NOT is_active) OR (unit_price_minor IS NOT NULL AND unit_price_minor > 0))

negotiations_amounts_positive.name: negotiations_amounts_positive
negotiations_amounts_positive.value: ("negotiations"."listed_price_minor" IS NULL OR "negotiations"."listed_price_minor" >= 1) AND ("negotiations"."offer_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "negotiations"."offer_amount_minor" >= 1) AND ("negotiations"."counter_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "negotiations"."counter_amount_minor" >= 1) AND "negotiations"."quantity" >= 1

offers_inventory_valid.name: offers_inventory_valid
offers_inventory_valid.value: reserved_quantity >= 0 AND ((inventory_mode = 'LIMITED' AND available_quantity IS NOT NULL AND available_quantity >= reserved_quantity) OR (inventory_mode = 'UNLIMITED' AND available_quantity IS NULL))

offers_pricing_valid.name: offers_pricing_valid
offers_pricing_valid.value: (pricing_mode IN ('FIXED', 'NEGOTIABLE') AND unit_price_minor IS NOT NULL AND unit_price_minor >= 1) OR (pricing_mode = 'OPEN_TO_OFFERS' AND (unit_price_minor IS NULL OR unit_price_minor >= 1))

order_fulfillments_failure_consistent.name: order_fulfillments_failure_consistent
order_fulfillments_failure_consistent.value: ("order_fulfillments"."status" = 'FAILED') = ("order_fulfillments"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("order_fulfillments"."failure_reason" IS NULL OR "order_fulfillments"."failure_reason" IN ('BUYER_UNAVAILABLE', 'ADDRESS_UNREACHABLE', 'SELLER_UNABLE', 'OTHER'))

phone_verification_consumption_requires_.name: phone_verification_consumption_requires_proof
phone_verification_consumption_requires_.value: "phone_verification_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR "phone_verification_challenges"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL

promotion_products_budget_terms.name: promotion_products_budget_terms
promotion_products_budget_terms.value: ("promotion_products"."charging_mode" = 'PREPAID_BUDGET') = ("promotion_products"."unit_charge_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "promotion_products"."unit_charge_minor" > 0 AND "promotion_products"."unit_charge_minor" <= "promotion_products"."price_minor" AND ("promotion_products"."max_budget_minor" IS NULL OR "promotion_products"."max_budget_minor" >= "promotion_products"."price_minor"))

transaction_locations_coordinates_range.name: transaction_locations_coordinates_range
transaction_locations_coordinates_range.value: "transaction_locations"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("transaction_locations"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "transaction_locations"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

transaction_locations_text_lengths.name: transaction_locations_text_lengths
transaction_locations_text_lengths.value: char_length("transaction_locations"."city") <= 100 AND char_length("transaction_locations"."area") <= 100 AND ("transaction_locations"."address_text" IS NULL OR char_length("transaction_locations"."address_text") <= 300) AND ("transaction_locations"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("transaction_locations"."note") <= 300)

transaction_locations_content_present.name: transaction_locations_content_present
transaction_locations_content_present.value: "transaction_locations"."redacted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("transaction_locations"."source" = 'DEVICE' AND "transaction_locations"."latitude" IS NOT NULL) OR ("transaction_locations"."source" = 'MANUAL' AND "transaction_locations"."address_text" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_locations_redaction_consiste.name: transaction_locations_redaction_consistent
transaction_locations_redaction_consiste.value: "transaction_locations"."redacted_at" IS NULL OR ("transaction_locations"."latitude" IS NULL AND "transaction_locations"."accuracy_meters" IS NULL AND "transaction_locations"."address_text" IS NULL AND "transaction_locations"."note" IS NULL)

courier_commission_receivables_settlemen.name: courier_commission_receivables_settlement_consistent
courier_commission_receivables_settlemen.value: ("courier_commission_receivables"."status" = 'SIMULATION_CLEARED') = ("courier_commission_receivables"."settlement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "courier_commission_receivables"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)

courier_fare_proposals_confirmation_cons.name: courier_fare_proposals_confirmation_consistent
courier_fare_proposals_confirmation_cons.value: ("courier_fare_proposals"."status" = 'AGREED') = ("courier_fare_proposals"."buyer_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "courier_fare_proposals"."courier_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)
